dct_creator_sm: Environics Institute for Survey Research (Environics Research Group, Toronto, ON).
dct_description_sm:
Environics reports generated from this dataset include “Housing Affordability” and “Public Opinion about Immigration & Refugees”.

The variables SAMP and sampletype appear to represent sampling information indicating whether telephone interviews were conducted via landline or cellphone; however, the two variables show different frequency counts in the dataset. This discrepancy may reflect differences in coding, missing values, or how the sample type was classified between the two variables.

As part of its Focus Canada public opinion research program (launched in 1976), the Environics Institute updated its research on Canadian attitudes about immigration and refugees, and Canadian attitudes about home ownership. This survey was conducted in partnership with the Century Initiative. This survey is based on telephone interviews conducted (via landline and cellphones) with 2,002 Canadians between September 4 and 17, 2023. A sample of this size drawn from the population produces results accurate to within plus or minus 2.2 percentage points in 19 out of 20 samples.
